q: If the length of shadow of a tower is equal to its height, the sun angle of elevation is:
If the length of shadow of a tower is equal to its height, the sun angle of elevation is (JAC Board Standard Pattern - Part 2):
e: tan θ = height / shadow = 1 ⇒ θ = 45°. (Class 10 JAC Board 10-Year Verified Answer).
